@Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler is unavailable: the automations tool returns a gateway authentication error on both list and status, so I can't create or check a recurring job. I haven't scheduled anything, so nothing will post on Monday.

Once the scheduler works, here's how I'd run it:

- **Sources:** #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so combining them doesn't expose anything new.
- **Content:** last week's activity from both channels, plus open customer items.
- **Excluded:** money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices). Those figures go only to Anselm, June and the account owner, so I'd leave them out of the channel digest. Operational facts such as seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and contacts stay in.

If you want, I can post a one-off digest for this week by hand now, and you or an admin can fix the scheduler auth so the recurring Monday 08:00 post can be set up.
